verdict.rationale: The docs say Braintrust records token usage, model parameters and latency for every request. A searchable, filterable Logs table exists, and Loop can build dashboards and configure monitoring, so per-request token visibility and dashboarding are evidenced. However, no evidence shows cost tracking or dashboards that aggregate usage by model or time period. Missing for 10: explicit cost/spend calculation, per-model and time-series usage dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
